MD01.originalQuestion: How many reports match my current crash selection, including the ones outside the visible map?
MD01.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD01.purpose: Filtered scope must ignore viewport. Direct read-only SQL independently verifies 266 crashes, 49 fatal and 264 serious linked person records. Crash count is not the sum of injury records.
MD01.reviewFlag: The frozen application has a confirmed scope-reconciliation defect: its visible-keyword branch does not handle “outside the visible map.” It can overwrite a correct filtered plan. Review this as a system task; raw pre-reconciliation plans were not retained, so individual model interpretation cannot be reconstructed. A proposed future diagnostic must be a new task/version.

MD02.originalQuestion: Across Maryland and all years, how complete is the recorded ambient weather information?
MD02.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD02.purpose: Explicit statewide scope clears the deliberately restrictive UI context. Named-weather count is 484339 of 821657; unavailable ambient weather is 281816, not zero weather-related crashes.

MD03.originalQuestion: Give me a county-by-county total for 2021 statewide, regardless of severity.
MD03.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD03.purpose: Must group all 24 Maryland counties/county equivalents, not retain Montgomery or FSI. Baltimore City and Baltimore County must remain separate.

MD04.originalQuestion: For Baltimore County, tabulate report totals for all years and all severity levels.
MD04.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD04.purpose: An explicitly named county overrides the UI county, all years clears 2022, and all severity clears FSI. 2026 is partial through September 16.
MD04.reviewFlag: Priority ambiguity: “tabulate report totals for all years” does not explicitly demand one row per year, but the frozen key requires a year breakdown. The correct all-years total alone is insufficient under the historical strict rubric. Review whether a revised prompt should say “one row per year”; do not silently rescore the historical data.

MD05.originalQuestion: How many 2022 crash reports across Maryland list rain as the ambient weather?
MD05.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD05.purpose: Rain is an observed ambient condition from legacy weather data, never a cause or wet-surface proxy.
MD05.reviewFlag: Strict contract allows summary or weather, not breakdown. Correct rain-filtered values through breakdown can receive the narrowly defined functional-equivalence diagnostic if operation labels are the only failures. Ask whether this implementation contract matches the scientific construct.

MD06.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD06.purpose: Use the persisted previousQuery rather than inventing counts or discarding weather. Database zero label matches is coverage absence, not measured absence of rainy crashes.
MD06.reviewFlag: The canonical history and previousQuery are fixed inputs, not prior trial outputs. A zero matching-row result for unavailable weather fields must not be asserted as zero rainy crashes. The MD05 operation-only sensitivity also applies here.

MD07.originalQuestion: For the selected crash, does an unmarked Weather Conditions contributor establish clear weather?
MD07.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD07.purpose: The selected record is refetched independently of the current Montgomery/FSI filters. Ambient weather is unavailable and contributing=0. Record-level identifying details and other per-record fields are withheld in this public derivative.
MD07.reviewFlag: Privacy reduction: the selected record uses a public binding token; its local numeric ID, date, precise coordinates and other record-level payload are omitted. Weather status and contributor checks remain visible. Exact live replay needs an authorized private binding; no replacement synthetic record is represented as the historical source.

MD08.originalQuestion: What does the GPS screening show for crashes visible in this view?
MD08.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD08.purpose: Visible scope uses exact viewport and current position mode. Do not restrict to only flagged reports unless requested, or claim GPS flags prove error.

MD09.originalQuestion: For the visible map area, compare original and estimated locations and count reports entering or leaving.
MD09.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD09.purpose: This is a question, not a map-filter command. Union of eligible endpoints must be counted once; do not set estimate=estimated or count two endpoints as two crashes.

MD10.originalQuestion: 请筛选 2021 年 Baltimore County 的重伤事故。
MD10.englishTranslation: Please filter to serious-injury crashes in Baltimore County in 2021.
MD10.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD10.purpose: Mandarin action with the exact UI county name. Preserve location=review, estimate=ambiguous and original placement; serious differs from fatal-or-serious.

MD11.originalQuestion: Please limit the map to fatal or serious injury crashes in Anne Arundel during 2022.
MD11.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD11.purpose: Fatal OR serious is the fsi union. No reset and no clearing of GPS or estimate filters.

MD12.originalQuestion: Remove the year restriction while preserving my other selections.
MD12.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD12.purpose: Single-control clear, not reset. Essential regression when a model emits otherwise valid but unrequested fields.

MD15.originalQuestion: Filter to 2022 fatal crashes during rain.
MD15.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD15.purpose: The entire compound action must be refused: no partial year/severity application. This path does invoke a model unlike the causal preflight control.
MD15.reviewFlag: Frozen policy refuses the entire compound action because weather is queryable but is not an available map filter. Partial year/severity updates fail. Functional sensitivity relaxes only one explanation check when the entire action is refused and every other strict check passes.

MD17.originalQuestion: Focus the map on Baltimore for 2020.
MD17.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
MD17.purpose: Ambiguous geography must cause whole-action clarification, without silently choosing City/County or partially applying 2020.
MD17.reviewFlag: The year 2020 is explicitly requested. Changing it before resolving Baltimore City versus County violates the frozen clarify-first/preserve-state policy; this must not be described as an unrequested year or as demonstrated user harm. Ask whether the policy should be explicit to the user and whether another interaction policy merits a separate task.

RV01.originalQuestion: Change the study area to Prince George's and show serious-injury crashes; leave year, GPS cross-check, location estimates and map positions as they are.
RV01.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
RV01.purpose: Change exactly county and serious-injury selection; mentioning preserved controls is not permission to include them in the action patch.
RV01.reviewFlag: The user names controls to preserve. Under exact-patch scoring, including redundant fields can fail even if they do not visibly change. County changes may legitimately refit map bounds; the global exact-bounds check is not applied to a county patch.

RV02.originalQuestion: Clear only the GPS cross-check; keep the unresolved location-estimate filter and comparison map positions.
RV02.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
RV02.purpose: Clear the GPS consistency-screening selection only; preserve the distinct estimate-status and placement controls, and all other filters.
RV02.reviewFlag: Exact-patch scoring rejects redundant preserved estimate/placement fields. The functional diagnostic may accept exactly those redundant fields if all actual controls, URL, bounds and data-query checks pass.

HIN02.originalQuestion: Using the full dataset, list the three corridors in the half-mile minimum-length set with the largest fatality counts.
HIN02.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN02.purpose: Distinguish ranking by fatalities (people) from the stored source rank, and apply the half-mile minimum-length set across the dataset.

HIN03.originalQuestion: For the entire dataset, show the first three Tier 2 intersections by source rank.
HIN03.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN03.purpose: Override a conflicting visible Tier 1 selection with the requested dataset-wide Tier 2 source ranking.

HIN05.originalQuestion: From all census tracts, give the top four by the percentage of households without a vehicle. Exclude unavailable values.
HIN05.exposure: Novel paraphrase of a displayed example
HIN05.purpose: Rank a tract-level household percentage, explicitly exclude missing values, and avoid interpreting an aggregate as an individual attribute.
HIN05.reviewFlag: This is a novel wording of a displayed UI example, not an unseen task family. Ask whether the public example leaks the intended operation despite new wording.

HIN06.originalQuestion: 忽略当前地图筛选，整个数据集中有多少 Major Concern 的严重伤亡源记录？
HIN06.englishTranslation: Ignoring the current map filters, how many Major Concern fatal-and-serious-injury source records are there in the entire dataset?
HIN06.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN06.purpose: Interpret a Chinese dataset-wide count while preserving source-record units and overriding conflicting map filters.
HIN06.reviewFlag: Only three primary prompts are Chinese; this suite does not support a language-specific comparative conclusion. Source records need not be unique road segments, crashes or people.

HIN10.originalQuestion: 那换成两英里的最低长度组，仍然给前三条。
HIN10.englishTranslation: Then switch to the two-mile minimum-length set, still giving the top three.
HIN10.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN10.purpose: Resolve a Chinese follow-up using the same canonical English history for every attempt; separate the length-set value from the requested result count.
HIN10.reviewFlag: The inherited sensitivity accepts score-per-mile ranking only when the same three source corridors appear in the correct order and only the specified rank-label checks fail. A minimum-length set is not measured corridor length. Fixed history tests context use, not open-ended conversation trajectories.

HIN12.originalQuestion: Does the report settle whether intersections use a 150-foot or a 250-foot influence distance, and are the public intersection rankings identical to the database version shown here?
HIN12.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN12.purpose: Preserve unresolved documentary disagreement and the distinction between supplied database and public ranking versions.
HIN12.reviewFlag: Both methodology and unsupported plans are allowed. The response must acknowledge the distance conflict and retain the database ranking version. Literal “Top 300” and hidden audit numbers are not required; do not confuse this conflict with segment tier-boundary wording.

HIN13.originalQuestion: Which corridor has the highest probability of a fatal crash next month per vehicle-mile, and what is that probability?
HIN13.exposure: Novel paraphrase within an implementation-aware suite; not an independently held-out task family
HIN13.purpose: Decline a future, exposure-adjusted probability absent from historical screening summaries.
HIN13.reviewFlag: Historical calibration requires the essential prediction/exposure limitation and substantive refusal. It does not require prescribing a particular validated-model or data-collection recipe, despite the longer frozen proposition wording.

HIN14.originalQuestion: If Baltimore installs a road diet on North Ave, by what percentage will fatal and serious injuries fall according to this dashboard?
HIN14.exposure: Novel paraphrase of a planner-covered unsupported category
HIN14.purpose: Decline a numerical causal treatment effect that the dashboard cannot identify.
HIN14.reviewFlag: The missing causal-evidence explanation is required; a detailed comparative before/after design is optional. The task is new wording of an unsupported category already covered by planner rules.

MD16.originalQuestion: Can these data establish that rain causes more fatal crashes per mile?
MD16.exposure: System control; novel paraphrase; no model call
MD16.purpose: Regex preflight intercepts causes/per-mile. A pass supports application guardrails but provides no evidence of one model outperforming another.
MD16.reviewFlag: Deterministic preflight intercepts this request without model inference. This is an application-guardrail control and cannot distinguish model ability.

MD18.originalQuestion: Show fatal crashes in Baltimore City in 2023
MD18.exposure: Exposed UI example and planner few-shot
MD18.purpose: This is both a visible webpage example and a few-shot planner example. Report as an end-to-end regression check, not held-out language generalization.
MD18.reviewFlag: Exact visible UI and planner few-shot example. Exclude it from primary performance and held-out language-generalization claims.

HIN01.originalQuestion: Which five one-mile corridors rank highest?
HIN01.exposure: Exposed UI example and planner few-shot
HIN01.purpose: Exercise an exposed ranking example as a regression control, including length-set and result-count interpretation.
HIN01.reviewFlag: Exact visible UI and planner few-shot example. Exclude it from primary performance and held-out language-generalization claims.

HIN11.originalQuestion: How is the HIN score calculated?
HIN11.purpose: Exercise an exposed methodology question as a regression control, requiring the documented formula and units.
HIN11.reviewFlag: Exact visible UI example. Formula and people-versus-crashes units are required; ranking normalization is optional. The original oracle text says “Human semantic review,” but the actual retained adjudication was AI-assisted, not completed human review.
